h: VeryDarkMan calls Davido and his uncle a disappointment over development in Osun
p: VeryDarkMan has described Davido and his uncle, Osun State Governor Ademola Adeleke, as a disappointment, criticising what he called poor development in the state. He asked how a family that owns private jets could have so much wealth while Osun still lacks a functioning airport, and how investors are expected to reach the state easily. He urged those in power to use government resources to improve people's lives.
more: VDM also spoke about a past invitation from Davido's brother, B-Red, to meet their father.
Neither Davido nor the Osun State government has responded to the comments.
Fans are split on whether his criticism is fair or too harsh on the Adeleke family.
